# KafkaOfflinePartitions

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| critical | kafka | [kafka-overview](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-overview/) | 1m / 0s |

**Summary:** Cluster <kafka_cluster> has offline partitions

At least one partition has no leader: neither producers nor consumers can use it. Usually all replicas of the partition are on brokers that are down, or unclean leader election is disabled and only out-of-sync replicas are left.

## Impact

Data in the offline partitions can be neither written nor read. This is an outage for every application using those topics.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Cluster Overview → Partition health and Brokers at a glance: which brokers are down?
2. `kafka-topics.sh --describe --unavailable-partitions` (or AKHQ) lists the partitions and their replicas.
3. All replicas of the partition must be on unavailable brokers, or only out-of-sync replicas are left (unclean.leader.election.enable=false).

## Mitigation

- Bring the brokers holding the replicas back (see KafkaBrokerDown).
- Last resort, accepting data loss: enable unclean leader election for the topic or run `kafka-leader-election.sh --election-type unclean`.

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster) (kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_offlinepartitionscount) > 0
```
